name: German-Czech Fund for the Future: Grants for Study Stays of German and Czech Students in the Neighbour Countries
summary: The German-Czech Fund for the Future was launched in 1998 to create and support trust, encounters and cooperation between Germans and Czechs. The Fund's scholarship programme is aimed at German and Czech students researching German-Czech
